svg.title: Assembly technician — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as assembly technician, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: A separate assembly peg aligns with a slotted fixture while a downward insertion arrow indicates the assembly direction. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face.
